landing.text:
HEADLINE
Produce compliant policy documents efficiently

SUBHEADLINE
For compliance officers at insurance companies, struggling to create accurate policy documents quickly.

WHAT THIS IS
A focused tool that helps compliance officers at insurance companies produce compliant policy documents efficiently.

WHO IT IS FOR
Compliance officers at insurance companies

THE PROBLEM
Inaccurate and delayed policy document creation hinders compliance.

WHY EXISTING TOOLS FAIL
Microsoft Word templates lack specific mechanics, forcing manual workarounds that slow outcomes.

HOW IT WORKS
Trained on internal language and regulatory requirements for accurate policy writing.

KEY BENEFITS
Early users reach their first outcome without the overhead of general-purpose alternatives.

CALL TO ACTION
Start producing compliant policy documents with our assistant.

ux.text:
UX CONTEXT
TARGET: product
Policy writing assistant helps compliance officers at insurance companies create accurate policy documents efficiently.

ONBOARDING
1. Start by creating a new profile.
2. Set up your account to access our library of regulatory requirements.
3. Input your company's specific policies and procedures.

EMPTY STATE
1. No policies found in your account yet. Add some today!
2. Your setup is incomplete. Finish it to start writing policies.
3. You have no results to view. Start generating policies now!

ERROR
1. Policy not saved: Check your input for errors and try again.
2. Regulatory requirement not found: Verify the requirement exists and try again.
3. Policy document not generated: Review your setup and try again.

TOAST
1. Profile created!
2. Account set up successfully!
3. Results ready!

BUTTON LABELS
1. Create Profile
2. Set Up Account
3. Generate Policy
4. Save Policy Document
5. Add Regulatory Requirement
6. Edit Policy Settings
7. View Policy Results
8. Start Writing Policies
